description: This file contains an Android activity that demonstrates text alignment features in graphics. It defines a class 'TextAlign' which extends GraphicsActivity and includes an inner class 'SampleView' that handles custom drawing to showcase text alignment, positioning, and drawing text along a path.

classes.name: TextAlign
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating text alignment and positioning using Canvas and Paint.

classes.name: SampleView
classes.description: A custom View subclass that performs graphic rendering of text with various alignments, including along a path.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Sets the content view to an instance of SampleView when the activity is created.

methods.name: makePath
methods.description: Constructs a Path object with a cubic Bezier curve for drawing text along a path.

methods.name: buildTextPositions
methods.description: Calculates and returns an array of positions for each character in a string, used for precise text placement.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Overrides the View's onDraw method to render text with various alignments and along a path.

methods.name: onSizeChanged
methods.description: Updates the horizontal position for text centering when the view size changes.
